def _build(self, initial: CommittedDelivery, assignment: WakeAssignment, owner: Thread) -> OptionalAwarenessResult:
    if owner.process_identity != ProcessIdentity.capture(os.getpid()):
        raise ProjectionUnavailableError('selected owner is not this process')
    if not owner.role.executable:
        raise ProjectionUnavailableError('selected owner is not executable')
    turn = owner.active_turn
    if turn is None or turn.admission_generation != self.expected_admission_generation:
        raise ProjectionUnavailableError('selected owner turn changed')
    if FrozenRecipient(assignment.recipient_lookup, assignment.recipient) != FrozenRecipient(owner.incarnation.lookup, owner.name):
        raise ProjectionUnavailableError('selected recipient changed')
    if (assignment.wire_seq, assignment.message_id) != (initial.message.seq, initial.message.message_id):
        raise ProjectionUnavailableError('selected source changed')
    if not self.after_seq < initial.message.seq <= self.through_seq:
        raise ProjectionUnavailableError('selected source is outside the captured window')
    _require_no_private_owner_rename(self.index.log.path.parent)
    root_id = initial.wire_root_id
    lookup = assignment.recipient_lookup
    page = self.index.page(root_id=root_id, recipient_lookup=lookup, after_seq=self.after_seq, required_through_seq=self.through_seq, limit=self.max_rows)
    if page.has_more:
        raise ProjectionUnavailableError('binding candidate decisions exceed the row budget')
    path = self.index.log.path.with_name('coordination.sqlite3')
    with CoordinationStore.observing(path) as db:
        self._verify_schema_and_owner(db, initial, assignment, owner)
        decisions = self._selected_decisions(db, root_id, lookup, page.through_seq)
        candidates = tuple(((row.source_seq, row.message_id, row.wake_mode, row.target) for row in page.entries))
        accepted = tuple((row.candidate for row in decisions))
        if candidates != accepted:
            raise ProjectionUnavailableError('candidate rows differ from sealed decisions')
        obligations = self._open_obligations(db, lookup)
        expected = OwnerGenerations(owner_lookup=lookup, owner_thread=owner.name, generation=self.expected_participant_generation)
        selected = [row for row in decisions if row.generation.current(expected)]
        if not any((row.assignment.assignment_id == assignment.assignment_id for row in selected)):
            raise ProjectionUnavailableError('current selected claim has no owner generation')
        current_obligations = [row for row in obligations if row.generation.current(expected)]
        historical_omitted = len(decisions) - len(selected) + (len(obligations) - len(current_obligations))
    self._verify_live_inclusion(path, lookup, owner)
    instruction = InstructionFile.read('selected-awareness.md')
    content_instruction = InstructionFile.read('selected-awareness-content.md')
    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(FieldCodec.encode((tuple(selected), tuple(current_obligations))), sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    result = CompleteAwareness(lookup, page.through_seq, tuple(selected), tuple(current_obligations), historical_omitted, instruction, content_instruction, provenance=(instruction.source, content_instruction.source, ResourceProvenance(str(path), digest, 'captured typed optional awareness rows'), *(WireProvenance(MessageReference(row.assignment.wire_seq, row.assignment.message_id)) for row in selected)))
    result.require_resource_budget(self.max_text_bytes)
    return result

def replies(self, references) -> Iterator[CommittedDelivery]:
    """Capture the deliveries that name any of these originals as answered.

        The index selects by sequence only; each decoded reply still carries
        its own reference, and its consumer checks it against the original.
        """
    marks = ','.join(('?' for _ in references))
    self.require_current()
    rows = DeliverySources.read(self.connection.execute(f'SELECT w.* FROM {DeliverySources.declared_name} w JOIN {Replies.declared_name} r ON r.seq=w.seq WHERE r.answered_seq IN ({marks}) ORDER BY w.seq', tuple((reference.seq for reference in references))))
    return self.capture_sources(tuple(rows))

def delivery(self, seq: int) -> CommittedDelivery:
    """Resolve an exact source sequence through this original opened proof."""
    self.require_current()
    row = DeliverySources.one(self.connection, seq=seq)
    if row is None:
        raise RelationViolationError('No committed initial sideband for this wire sequence.')
    original, = self.capture_sources((row,))
    self.require_current()
    return original

def publish_initial_cohort(self, message: Message, *, control: str='ordinary', _bus_lock: StoreLock | None=None, _human_origin: HumanOrigin | None=None) -> Message:
    """Commit public envelope and FULL N private decisions in the SAME fsynced row.

        This private path assumes cooperating Comms writers hold the global
        wire lock. It never publishes from a caller-supplied audience or claim.
        """
    from .audience_manifest import MAX_WIRE_SEQ, FrozenRecipient, freeze_audience
    from .wake import ControlClassification, resolve_wake_cohort
    if self._private_initial_writes is not True:
        raise RelationViolationError('Private initial publication is disabled.')
    if _human_origin is not None and type(_human_origin) is not HumanOrigin:
        raise RelationViolationError('Human initial requires a typed local USER origin.')
    if message.claim_transition is not None:
        raise RelationViolationError('An initial cohort cannot carry resource claims.')
    classification = ControlClassification(control)
    if not classification.supports_initial:
        raise RelationViolationError('System-control initial issuer is not available.')
    with nullcontext(_bus_lock) if _bus_lock is not None else self.log.locked() as bus_lock, ExitStack() as resources:
        _require_no_private_owner_rename(self.log.path.parent)
        metadata = self.log._private_marker_unlocked()
        metadata.access.require_append()
        from .private_bus_checkpoint import opened_private_checkpoint_unlocked
        source = bus_lock.source
        if source is None:
            source = resources.enter_context(opened_private_checkpoint_unlocked(self.log, metadata))
        source.require_marker(metadata)
        previous_sequence = source.committed_sequence()
        if metadata.last_seq >= MAX_WIRE_SEQ:
            raise RelationViolationError('Private bus sequence is exhausted.')
        source_paths = (self._registry.store.path, self._channels.path)
        before_revisions = tuple((FileRevision.capture(path) for path in source_paths))
        snapshot = self._registry.snapshot()
        catalog = self._channels.read()
        sender, target = self._validate_publish_request(message, registry_snapshot=snapshot, catalog=catalog)
        sender_thread = snapshot.threads.get(sender)
        if sender_thread is None or not snapshot.statuses[sender].visible:
            raise RelationViolationError('Initial sender must be visible and registered.')
        message.type.require_publishable(message, Path(sender_thread.worktree))
        if _human_origin is None:
            if not sender_thread.role.executable:
                raise RelationViolationError('Initial sender must be a visible registered executable.')
        else:
            _human_origin.require_registered(snapshot)
            if message.sender != _human_origin.sender:
                raise RelationViolationError('Local USER origin differs from registered identity.')
        if not is_channel_target(target):
            target = snapshot.canonical_name(target)
            recipient = snapshot.threads.get(target)
            if recipient is None or not snapshot.statuses[target].visible:
                raise RelationViolationError('Initial direct target must be visible.')
            if target == sender:
                raise RelationViolationError('A thread cannot message itself.')
            names = [target] if recipient.role.executable else []
            if not recipient.role.executable:
                message = replace(message, notice=True)
        else:
            channel = catalog.resolve(target)
            names = [name for name, thread in snapshot.threads.items() if name != sender and thread.role.executable and snapshot.statuses[name].visible and channel.matches(thread.tags)]
        selected = [snapshot.threads[name] for name in names]
        lookups = [thread.incarnation.lookup for thread in selected]
        sender_lookup = snapshot.threads[sender]

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class DeliveredInput(QueuedInput):
    """A pending bus message handed to its recipient's running turn.

    Its assignment is paused while the turn holds it. A proved start settles it
    as delivered; an input never written returns it to pending for an ordinary
    wake. One written without a proved start stays paused and is never resent.
    """
    bus_key: str
    message: Message
    assignment: WakeAssignment

    @property
    def key(self) -> str:
        return self.bus_key

    def queue_items(self, scope: QueueScope) -> tuple[QueueItem, ...]:
        return ()

    def source(self) -> DeliveredFollowingInput:
        return DeliveredFollowingInput(keys=(self.key,), accepted_id=self.input_id, goal_permission=AcceptedGoalPermission(self.context.active_goal_id), origins=(self.message,))

    @classmethod
    def reserve_pending(cls, inputs: InputDrain, name: str, root_id: str, pending: tuple[tuple[CommittedDelivery, WakeAssignment], ...], sources: tuple[TurnInputSource, ...], reserved: list[tuple[Self, InputContent]]) -> None:
        """Fill the original reservation scope in a joined, wire-locked worker.

        The caller owns ``reserved`` and its AsyncExitStack before work starts,
        so cancellation cannot lose a successfully paused but unplaced input.
        The worker opens/closes SQLite and never reads or mutates live queues.
        """
        from .agent_backend import InputContent
        from .context_segments.wake import DeliveredMessageSegment
        from .routing import ScheduledTurn
        from .turn_context import TurnContext
        with _store_lock(inputs.comms._wire_lock_path):
            accepted = pending[:max(cls.remaining_capacity(inputs, sources), 0)]
            if not accepted:
                return
            snapshot = inputs.comms.registry.snapshot()
            canonical = snapshot.canonical_name(name)
            owner = snapshot.threads[canonical]
            context = QueuedInputContext.capture(owner, snapshot.admission_identity(canonical))
            document = inputs.dispositions.read(tuple((InputDispositions.bus_key(source.message, owner) for source, _ in accepted)))
            with Coordination(str(inputs.comms.root / 'coordination.sqlite3')) as store:
                for source, assignment in accepted:
                    message = source.message
                    key = InputDispositions.bus_key(message, owner)
                    if document.lookup(key).exists:
                        continue
                    rendered = TurnContext.render_segments((DeliveredMessageSegment.capture(source, assignment, owner),))
                    row = ReservedInput(key, message.seq, canonical, context.admission.admission_generation, message.target, ScheduledTurn.incoming(message, aliases=snapshot.aliases).prompt, origin=WireInputOrigin(root_id, message.reference))
                    with ExitStack() as custody:
                        inputs.dispositions.reserve_originals(row, custody=custody)
                        paused = store.assignments.transition_preengagement(assignment.assignment_id, DeferredAssignment, expected_revision=assignment.revision).value
                        custody.callback(store.assignments.restore_unbound_delivery, paused)
                        reserved.append((cls(text=row.source_text, echo=False, context=context, input_id=ACPInputIdText.new(), prompt=rendered.text, bus_key=key, message=message, assignment=paused), InputContent(text=rendered.text, contributions=rendered.contributions)))
                        custody.pop_all()

    @staticmethod
    async def _restore_unplaced(inputs: InputDrain, session_id: str, reserved: list[tuple[DeliveredInput, InputContent]]) -> None:
        placed = inputs.queued_inputs.get(session_id, {})
        unplaced = tuple((item for item, _content in reserved if placed.get(item.input_id) is not item))
        for item in unplaced:
            await item.not_started

def addressed_sources(self, lookup: str, after_seq: int=0) -> Iterator[CommittedDelivery]:
    """Borrow bounded pages from one original committed append-only cut.

        A later append cannot extend this iteration. Each page captures exact
        original pointers and bytes inside certification; validation and all
        consumer work occur after its publication custody has closed.
        """
    request = AddressedPage(lookup=lookup, after_seq=after_seq)
    with self.certified_read() as source:
        witness, captured, more = source.addressed_page(self, request)
    while True:
        originals = tuple(captured)
        yield from originals
        if not more:
            return
        request = replace(request, after_seq=originals[-1].message.seq)
        with self.certified_read() as source:
            _, captured, more = source.addressed_page(self, request, prefix=witness)
